purpose: 1080p30 operating points; a measurement, not a round

held_out.name: public_minecraft
held_out.action: decimated 60 to 30 by taking every other frame

held_out.name: public_sintel
held_out.action: excluded: 24 fps does not decimate to 30 by an integer stride, and resampling would change the pixels being scored

interpretation: At 30 fps a given map Mbps buys twice the bytes per frame it does at 60, while decimation doubles the temporal distance so prediction is harder. These are the net; most of the gain over the 1080p60 ladder is the frame-rate halving, not a codec improvement.

gpu.excludes: uploads, readback, transport, capture, game rendering

recommendation.reason: VMAF 77.755 mean with a 71.743 per-frame floor at 5.6705 map Mbps, decoding in 15.065 ms per draw with zero CPU/GPU divergence. The low-bandwidth alternative saves 1.88 map Mbps but drops the per-frame floor to 64.101, which is where the grass and foliage failure in the worst-region crops becomes visible.
